scheme_name: Marriage Grant for the Marriage of the Daughter of War Disabled Ex-Servicemen above 50% Disability
other_conditions: Applicant must be a bonafide resident of Haryana.
Applicant must be a war‑disabled ex‑serviceman with disability assessed above 50%.
Benefit can be claimed for up to two daughters only.
Each eligible daughter must be at least 18 years old.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹21,000 per daughter for the marriage of up to two eligible daughters.
